recipes.name: baguette
recipes.issue: The 18 kg column actually starts with 111 kg flour. Improver is 3% of flour; verify its specified dose. The 200 g/100 CFA format is much weaker than the 90 g format.

recipes.name: Baguette AI
recipes.issue: D uses 18 kg flour despite its 10 kg heading. F and J use different salt/improver ratios, so they are separate formulas. Bulk revenue uses 12 pieces for 1,000 CFA.

recipes.name: Banh Mi
recipes.issue: The 50 kg column actually has 150 kg flour. Correct sugar from 37,000 to the master 32,000 per 50 kg. Very low salt and 2.5% improver require recipe review.

recipes.name: cake marbre
recipes.issue: Piece-count formulas divide batch COST by piece weight. Historical ingredient rates differ sharply from the master. Milk identity is unclear. No cocoa/chocolate line identifies the marbling.

lines.note: Milk type unclear; generic master milk rate used provisionally.

recipes.name: gateau
recipes.issue: Frying oil is entered as 10 against a pack weight of 20; units and net oil consumption are unresolved. Butter uses 20,000 g instead of 9,500 g. Condensed milk and egg mass need confirmation.

lines.note: Generic milk price used provisionally for condensed milk; confirm identity.
Frying oil excluded from dough yield; stated charge is not measured net consumption. Quantity unit unresolved; no invented conversion.

recipes.name: buns new look
recipes.issue: D/F/H/N are different formulas, not exact scales. D16 omits the 100 g EDC. Manual per-bun costs use selling weight/price instead of ingredient cost.

recipes.name: Donuts
recipes.issue: Keep the 5 kg frying-oil charge out of dough yield. Its full cost is charged provisionally; measure oil consumed/discarded. Large-scale cost and quantity use different multipliers; sales formulas have broken references.

lines.note: Frying oil excluded from dough yield; stated charge is not measured net consumption.

recipes.name: Fish Pie
recipes.issue: Cabbage (200 g) is unpriced. Improver points to baking powder. Filling trim/cook losses and labour are missing. Manual 60 g/100 CFA differs from the main 85 g/100 CFA format.

recipes.name: Galette
recipes.issue: Baking powder uses a 4,000 g milk-tantalizer denominator instead of 500 g. Manual per-piece cost is a price/weight ratio, not ingredient cost. EDC identity needs confirmation.

recipes.name: New bread
recipes.issue: Condensed milk combines a milk price with a 25 kg powder-milk pack. Egg denominator is 540 g rather than the master 1,500 g. The purported 50 kg batch contains 125 kg flour.

lines.note: Generic milk price used provisionally for condensed milk; confirm identity.

recipes.name: NGALA BREAD
recipes.issue: Condensed milk uses the 25 kg powder-milk denominator. Egg pack weight is inconsistent. Manual cost formulas contain broken references.

lines.note: Generic milk price used provisionally for condensed milk; confirm identity.

recipes.name: Pain au lait
recipes.issue: E19 omits ingredients after yeast although D19 includes them. The purported 18 kg batch starts with 43.2 kg flour. Confirm milk identity, EDC and flavour dosage.

recipes.name: NEW BRIOCHE
recipes.issue: The secondary batch total omits rows and is not a faithful scale. The 82 g/100 CFA entry needs separate economics from 140 g/200 CFA. Compare flavour and demand before combining with brioche.

recipes.name: Brioche Professionel
recipes.issue: E15 omits yeast and nutmeg. The 50 kg column starts with only 13.64 kg flour. Condensed-milk identity is unresolved; the manual 80 g/100 CFA is weaker than 70 g/100 CFA.

lines.note: Generic milk price used provisionally for condensed milk; confirm identity.

recipes.name: professinal Buns
recipes.issue: E19 omits milk flavour, oil and nutmeg. Sales formulas multiply price twice. Water is only 300 g per 10 kg flour: confirm an omitted liquid before production.

lines.note: Generic milk price used provisionally for condensed milk; confirm identity.

recipes.name: brioche
recipes.issue: Secondary batch quantities are blank. Some profit cells deduct 16% of ingredient surplus without a supported expense basis. Compare with NEW BRIOCHE by taste and measured yield.

recipes.name: Chinchin
recipes.issue: Oil is entered as 2 and priced as 2 g; confirm its unit and consumption. The manual 30 g / 1,200 CFA pair lacks a price header and is only a possible offer, requiring confirmation. Egg mass is 1,200 g for 3,600 g flour.

lines.note: Frying oil excluded from dough yield; stated charge is not measured net consumption. Quantity unit unresolved; no invented conversion.

recipes.name: choko bread
recipes.issue: Old hard-coded prices and a powder-sized milk pack. Milk is provisionally mapped to powder milk. Base-cost total omits chocolate while scaled cost includes it.

lines.note: 25 kg source pack suggests powder; confirm identity.

recipes.name: YUMMY BREAD
recipes.issue: Flour Bir at 20,000/50 kg is retained. The source total omits 100 g EDC. D/F/H are different formulas; 125 and 150 CFA are separate prices for the same 139 g piece.

recipes.name: Kouatchoua gato
recipes.issue: Exclude 8 kg frying oil from dough yield, while provisionally charging its full cost. Condensed-milk identity remains unclear. The older report included fryer oil in saleable mass.

lines.note: Generic milk price used provisionally for condensed milk; confirm identity.
Frying oil excluded from dough yield; stated charge is not measured net consumption.

recipes.name: Cake Prof
recipes.issue: D and H are materially different egg/butter/sugar formulas. Its profit-margin cell is a markup on cost. Use one approved formula and a measured cooled yield.

recipes.name: Best Chinchin
recipes.issue: The 15 kg frying-oil line is excluded from dough mass but fully charged provisionally. Improver is incorrectly priced as milk. Smaller-batch ingredient ratios differ.

lines.note: Frying oil excluded from dough yield; stated charge is not measured net consumption.

recipes.name: Sugar Balls
recipes.issue: Improver is priced as baking powder. No frying-oil consumption is costed. Small and large batch formulas differ. The 500 CFA offer is a price hypothesis, not evidence of demand.

lines.note: Measure net oil cost allocated to this batch; source has no line.

recipes.name: Beignet soufle
recipes.issue: Use the explicit 6 kg-flour F column. D/H are scaled from a different 7 kg formula. Frying oil is absent. Confirm EDC identity and dose.

lines.note: Measure net oil cost allocated to this batch; source has no line.

recipes.name: Zebree
recipes.issue: Baking powder uses the wrong pack weight; EDC uses a 25 kg milk-powder pack. Large and small formulas differ, including chocolate and butter.

recipes.name: Danisa biscuits
recipes.issue: The 2 kg and trial formulas change sugar/egg ratios. The 30 g/50 CFA offer has a different price per gram from large packs. Packaging and cooled biscuit yield are missing.

recipes.name: Delice
recipes.issue: Baking powder pack weight is wrong. The smaller formula omits honey and changes butter/sugar. Manual 86 g/100 CFA needs its own lower-margin calculation.

recipes.name: Okinawa
recipes.issue: Egg is priced as butter. Exclude the 1 kg frying-oil line from yield but charge it provisionally. No water line is supplied; confirm the formula before judging texture or yield.

lines.note: Frying oil excluded from dough yield; stated charge is not measured net consumption.

recipes.name: CAKE NOW
recipes.issue: Water row is blank and treated as unused in the listed formula. The 100 CFA row without a weight cannot be costed. Source margin is markup, not sales margin.

recipes.name: Short bread
recipes.issue: Salt is 150 g per 2 kg flour (7.5%): confirm transcription before production. The smaller formula changes ratios. Two weights are sold at the same 50 CFA price.

recipes.name: Melto
recipes.issue: F scales H, but H has 50 g egg while D has 150 g. The 50 kg column has 56.25 kg flour. At 50 CFA, moving from 34 to 45 g sharply reduces margin.

recipes.name: Kumba bread
recipes.issue: Secondary sales rows reference empty batches. Wholesale formulas imply 12 pieces of 900 g for only 1,000 CFA, apparently a copied pricing error. The 80 g manual offer differs from 90 g main offer.

recipes.name: Hamburger buns
recipes.issue: EDC uses powder-milk pack weight. Scaled batches use a different formula. The 370–700 g sale sizes look like loaves/packs; confirm units and whether any filling is included.

recipes.name: Taste it
recipes.issue: Baking powder denominator is wrong. The 800 g/1,000 CFA format has a lower margin than 700 g at the same price. Manual costs use price/weight, not recipe cost.

recipes.name: Samosa
recipes.issue: No frying oil or spices are listed. Filling cooking loss and assembly labour are missing. Salt is 110 g for 1,500 g flour; check formula and batch basis.

lines.note: Measure net oil cost allocated to this batch; source has no line.

recipes.name: Ice Cream
recipes.issue: The 200 g stabilizer is 1.29% of mix: verify the specific product dose. The 200 g others are priced but unidentified. Overrun cannot increase saleable grams; cups, refrigeration and cleaning are missing.

lines.note: Recipe price retained; item identity unknown.

recipes.name: Melto1
recipes.issue: H is not an exact scale of D. Its 50 kg column uses 50.04 kg flour. Confirm the distinct product purpose versus Melto; the 45 g/50 CFA format is weaker.

recipes.name: Croissant
recipes.issue: Source margin uses D18=350 rather than C18=45. Confirm whether 1,000 g butter includes all lamination butter. Lamination labour, trim and refrigeration are uncosted.

recipes.name: Universal bread
recipes.issue: Exclude 9 kg frying oil from dough yield while provisionally charging it in full. Condensed-milk identity is unresolved. The old report overstated output by including fryer oil.

lines.note: Generic milk price used provisionally for condensed milk; confirm identity.
Frying oil excluded from dough yield; stated charge is not measured net consumption.

recipes.name: Sheet3
recipes.issue: This is an unnamed but populated bread recipe, so it is included. Name and approve it before use. D/F/H formulations and manual price calculations differ.

recipes.name: Croissant new
recipes.issue: Layering butter points to EDC price divided by powder-milk weight. Reprice its 600 g at the master butter rate, provisionally. Confirm that the quoted fat is suitable for lamination.
